outcome.text:
# Issue #346: Run the Policymaker script that binds run records to manifest bytes (gap delta #330 N1, review #318 finding 4)

## Goal
Task #341 ended partial on input_budget (429k input, no change). The Policymaker wrote the change as an idempotent, hash-gated script. Run it once from main.

Expected gain: `run_record.py --check` proves manifest-content binding (one matching control accepted, a wrong-content hash and a one-byte change rejected), the last public non-resource defect of the run-record contract. The next Policymaker checks main: `run_record.py --check` prints `manifest_binding` with two `rejected` entries, evaluator exit 0, missing [], 62 refs.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Write `.session/report.md` first.
- [ ] Run `python3 -I -B execution/scripts/bind_manifest_n1.py` once. It changes only benchmark/scripts/run_record.py, benchmark/baseline/README.md, benchmark/preparation-status.json and benchmark/preparation.json.
- [ ] Run `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/run_record.py --check`, `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/baseline.py --check`, `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/score.py --check` and `python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`. Report exit codes and the sha256 lines the script prints.
- [ ] Do not edit any file by hand. Do not run `git commit`; the parent commits. No `__pycache__` files.
- [ ] If the script prints ERROR, stop and report the exact line.

## Verification
`python3 -I -B policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`

## Context
- `execution/scripts/bind_manifest_n1.py`: the script (dry run by the Policymaker on a copy of main).

## Budget
- At most 8 tool calls. Do not read benchmark/cases or benchmark/results bodies.
